decision_conditions: <p>The proposal is therefore NOT a lawful development.</p>

<p><span style="line-height:150%"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="line-height:150%">It has not been demonstrated that the materials used in the facing flank elevations of the rear dormer, when viewed from ground level, would appear to be of similar colour and design to the materials used in the main roof of the subject dwellinghouse. The proposed dormer would not therefore be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B, Condition B.2 (a) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></span></span><br></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial="">The window in the gable end which is</span></span> <span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial="">an </span></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial="">upper-floor window located in a wall forming a side elevation of the dwellinghouse </span></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial="">is not </span></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial="">obscure-glazed, and</span></span> <span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial="">non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed</span></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span arial=""> The proposed window would not be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B, Condition B.2 (c) (i) and (ii).</span></span></span><br></p>
description: CERTIFICATE OF LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT (PROPOSED):Alterations and extension to roof to form end gable; rear dormer with Juliette balcony; two rooflights in front roofslope; window in end gable; front porch; single storey rear extension (demolition of conservatory)
